display.purpose: Hero headline, section titles, entry titles — 800 weight, uppercase.

label.purpose: Zone letters, nav, badges, tags — 700 weight, tracked, uppercase.

motion.name: flip-board
motion.purpose: Departures-board flip-in, reserved for Experience entries only.

motion.name: reveal-fade
motion.purpose: Default scroll reveal for every other section.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #f2b705; color: #071f4d; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Overpass', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 14px; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f2b705; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Zone Badge
components.description: Filled blue square with a bold white letter, paired left of every section title.
components.css: .ds-zone-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; background: #0a2f6e; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Overpass', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; }

components.name: Pictogram
components.description: Domain icon tile used once in the hero (Data / Front-End / Software).
components.css: .ds-pictogram { width: 64px; height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f2b705; color: #071f4d; }

components.name: Boarding Now Tag
components.description: Amber status tag marking the current Experience entry — deliberately not a border accent.
components.css: .ds-status-tag { background: #f2b705; color: #071f4d; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'Overpass', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as an airport wayfinding system, not a résumé and not a dashboard: committed signage-blue field panels alternate with high-contrast white, one signal-amber highlight marks arrows, live status, and key phrases, and a single sans family (Overpass, derived from U.S. highway signage type) carries every weight of the hierarchy through scale alone. Sections are zones, lettered A through F. The Experience section is a departures board: each role flips into place, and the current role carries a 'Boarding Now' tag.
keyCharacteristics: Committed blue/white color-blocking, not a neutral ground with a timid accent
One typeface family (Overpass) for everything — no display/body/mono split
Zone-lettered sections (A–F) as a real structural device
A departures-board flip is the one signature motion moment, reserved for Experience only
Pictogram icons stand in for domain expertise the way gate signage uses pictograms for services

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only color that means 'look here' or 'this is current'; it never becomes a field color.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Every piece of type on the page is Overpass; vary weight and size, never family.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: A section either IS a color (full-bleed blue) or sits flat on paper; nothing is elevated.

dos: Do treat section background color as the primary structural signal.
Do keep the departures-board flip exclusive to Experience.
Do set all type in Overpass; vary weight and size, never family.
donts: Don't add a border-left/right accent stripe to signal state — use a filled tag instead (detect.mjs flags this as side-tab).
Don't introduce a second highlight color alongside amber.
Don't use a literal pixel font-size — stay on the documented type scale.
